																		Airforece Agniveer Vayu Musician (Intake 01/2027)

																		 
																		
																		
																		
																			Passed Matriculation / 10th or equivalent with minimum pass marks from any Govt. recognized School / Board.
																			Music Ability : (i) Candidates must have proficiency in music with accuracy in tempo, pitch and singing one complete song. They should be able to perform one preparatory tune and any of the notations i.e. Staff notation/ Tablature/ Tonic Solfa/ Hindustani/ Carnatic etc. Candidates must be able to tune individual instruments (in case of instruments require tuning) and match unknown notes on vocal or instruments.        (ii) Candidates must have proficiency in playing any one instrument 
																			Musical Experience Certificate: (i) Grade 5th or equivalent or above in one instrument from a recognized music institute such as TCL or RSM, KM Music Conservatory, Bangalore School of Music, TSM, GMI, Berklee School of Music etc.
																			OR
																			(ii) Diploma or equivalent in the field of music for candidates performing Hindustani or Carnatic Classical Music from any recognized University.
																			OR
																			(iii) Certificate of participation/ awards presented at various events. For such candidates’ performance/ playing of blowing instruments with staff notation as mentioned in Educational QRs.
																			For More Details, Read the Official Notification.
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
															
															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
																Weight: Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
																Visual Standards: 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D,  Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II
															

															 

															
																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes  (For Female Candidates) 
																Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) &  10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).
															

															 

															
																
																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.
																
																
																Refractive Error Limits:

																
																	
																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.
																
																
																Important Notes & Requirements
																
															

															
																Prescription & Spectacles: Candidates using corrected vision must bring their latest eye prescription (not older than one month) and their spectacles.
																Prescription Details: The prescription must include the diopter measurement, name, signature, stamp, and registration number of the Ophthalmologist. The date must be within one month prior to the medical examination.
																Surgical Disqualification: Candidates with a history of LASIK or PRK surgery will not be accepted.
																Additional Details: Full medical standards are available on the CASB web portal (https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in/agniveervayu/).

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
																Weight: Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
																Visual Standards: 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D,  Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II
															

															 

															
																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes  (For Female Candidates) 
																Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) &  10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).
															

															 

															
																
																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.
																
																
																Refractive Error Limits:

																
																	
																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.
																
																
																Important Notes & Requirements
																
															

															
																Prescription & Spectacles: Candidates using corrected vision must bring their latest eye prescription (not older than one month) and their spectacles.
																Prescription Details: The prescription must include the diopter measurement, name, signature, stamp, and registration number of the Ophthalmologist. The date must be within one month prior to the medical examination.
																Surgical Disqualification: Candidates with a history of LASIK or PRK surgery will not be accepted.
																Additional Details: Full medical standards are available on the CASB web portal (https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in/agniveervayu/).

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
																Weight: Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.

																Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) &  10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).
															

															 

															
																
																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.
																
																
																Refractive Error Limits:

																
																	
																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.

																			Passed Matriculation / 10th or equivalent with minimum pass marks from any Govt. recognized School / Board.

They should be able to perform one preparatory tune and any of the notations i.e. Staff notation/ Tablature/ Tonic Solfa/ Hindustani/ Carnatic etc. Candidates must be able to tune individual instruments (in case of instruments require tuning) and match unknown notes on vocal or instruments.        (ii) Candidates must have proficiency in playing any one instrument

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
																Weight: Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
																Visual Standards: 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D,  Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II
															

															 

															
																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes  (For Female Candidates) 
																Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) &  10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).
															

															 

															
																
																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.
																
																
																Refractive Error Limits:

																
																	
																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.
																
																
																Important Notes & Requirements
																
															

															
																Prescription & Spectacles: Candidates using corrected vision must bring their latest eye prescription (not older than one month) and their spectacles.
																Prescription Details: The prescription must include the diopter measurement, name, signature, stamp, and registration number of the Ophthalmologist. The date must be within one month prior to the medical examination.
																Surgical Disqualification: Candidates with a history of LASIK or PRK surgery will not be accepted.

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
																Weight: Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
																Visual Standards: 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D,  Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II
															

															 

															
																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes  (For Female Candidates) 
																Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) &  10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).
															

															 

															
																
																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.
																
																
																Refractive Error Limits:

																
																	
																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.
																
																
																Important Notes & Requirements
																
															

															
																Prescription & Spectacles: Candidates using corrected vision must bring their latest eye prescription (not older than one month) and their spectacles.
																Prescription Details: The prescription must include the diopter measurement, name, signature, stamp, and registration number of the Ophthalmologist. The date must be within one month prior to the medical examination.
																Surgical Disqualification: Candidates with a history of LASIK or PRK surgery will not be accepted.
																Additional Details: Full medical standards are available on the CASB web portal (https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in/agniveervayu/).

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
																Weight: Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
																Visual Standards: 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D,  Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II
															

															 

															
																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes  (For Female Candidates) 
																Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) &  10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).
															

															 

															
																
																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.
																
																
																Refractive Error Limits:

																
																	
																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.
																
																
																Important Notes & Requirements
																
															

															
																Prescription & Spectacles: Candidates using corrected vision must bring their latest eye prescription (not older than one month) and their spectacles.

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.

																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms

																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.

																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.

																	Myopia: Maximum -1D

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms

																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.

																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.

																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.

																		Airforece Agniveer Vayu Musician (Intake 01/2027)

																		 
																		
																		
																		
																			Passed Matriculation / 10th or equivalent with minimum pass marks from any Govt. recognized School / Board.
																			Music Ability : (i) Candidates must have proficiency in music with accuracy in tempo, pitch and singing one complete song. They should be able to perform one preparatory tune and any of the notations i.e. Staff notation/ Tablature/ Tonic Solfa/ Hindustani/ Carnatic etc. Candidates must be able to tune individual instruments (in case of instruments require tuning) and match unknown notes on vocal or instruments.        (ii) Candidates must have proficiency in playing any one instrument 
																			Musical Experience Certificate: (i) Grade 5th or equivalent or above in one instrument from a recognized music institute such as TCL or RSM, KM Music Conservatory, Bangalore School of Music, TSM, GMI, Berklee School of Music etc.

																			(ii) Diploma or equivalent in the field of music for candidates performing Hindustani or Carnatic Classical Music from any recognized University.

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
																Weight: Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
																Visual Standards: 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D,  Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II
															

															 

															
																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes  (For Female Candidates) 
																Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) &  10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).
															

															 

															
																
																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.
																
																
																Refractive Error Limits:

																
																	
																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.
																
																
																Important Notes & Requirements
																
															

															
																Prescription & Spectacles: Candidates using corrected vision must bring their latest eye prescription (not older than one month) and their spectacles.
																Prescription Details: The prescription must include the diopter measurement, name, signature, stamp, and registration number of the Ophthalmologist. The date must be within one month prior to the medical examination.
																Surgical Disqualification: Candidates with a history of LASIK or PRK surgery will not be accepted.
																Additional Details: Full medical standards are available on the CASB web portal (https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in/agniveervayu/).

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
																Weight: Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
																Visual Standards: 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D,  Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II

																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.

																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.

																Prescription & Spectacles: Candidates using corrected vision must bring their latest eye prescription (not older than one month) and their spectacles.

															Agniveer Vayu Musician 01/2027 :- Mandatory Medical Standards

															
																Height:-
																For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
																For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
																Weight: Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
																Chest:-
																(i) For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
																(ii) For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
																Hearing: Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
																Dental: Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.

																Physical Fitness Test (PFT). PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes  (For Female Candidates) 
																Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) &  10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).
															

															 

															
																
																Visual Standards:- 
																
																
																Visual Acuity: Must be 6/12 in each eye, correctable to 6/6 in each eye.
																
																
																Refractive Error Limits:

																
																	
																	Hypermetropia: Maximum +2.0D
																	
																	
																	Myopia: Maximum -1D
																	
																	
																	Astigmatism: Includes up to ± 0.50 D
																	
																
																
																
																Colour Vision: Must meet the CP-II standard.
																
																
																Important Notes & Requirements
																
															

															
																Prescription & Spectacles: Candidates using corrected vision must bring their latest eye prescription (not older than one month) and their spectacles.
